units: <cite ref="Menachot 35a:15">Men. 35ᵃ</cite> <he>כי מיתלי ביה בש׳ וכ׳</he> when you hang a weight on (stretch) the leather, and it rebounds again, it is old.—Pl. <he>שְׁלָחַיָּה</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 7:3:2">Y. Ned. VII, end, 40ᶜ</cite> <he>כגון אילין ש׳</he> (ed. Zyt. <he>שלחים</he>, corr. acc.) as, for instance, hides (which are sometimes used for covers).
